# Feature map

A later chat reads this instead of exploring the code. Every optional product area has a switch in `src/config/features.ts` (`FEATURES`, with labels and dependencies in `FEATURE_INFO`). A switch that is off means: its routes redirect away and never load, its menu, footer, account and admin links are hidden, its home-page sections do not render, and the code stays so a client can turn it on later. The switches are build-time and only change the browser app; the server functions in `api/` read Firestore settings instead. `isOn(key)` is false when a dependency is off. `isAnyOn([...])` and the array form of `FeatureGate` open a page when any listed feature is on.

How to read the tables: **Default** is the value in `FEATURES` (shipped state). **Size** is the work to set the feature up for a client who keeps it, using the sizes in `ESTIMATES.md`: S = settings or copy, no account (one key in the environment still counts as S); M = an account to connect, rules to agree, or a money flow to test; L = an outside business account that needs approval, plus testing across several flows.

## Runtime settings (money features)

Rewards, Scratch & Win and dealers each have a second, runtime on/off that an admin sets in the admin panel. All three start **off** in a fresh store (`enabled: false`), so a client who keeps the switch still has to turn the programme on. The switch decides whether the feature exists in the store; the runtime setting decides whether it is running.

- **Rewards:** Firestore `siteSettings/rewards`; defaults in `src/lib/rewards.ts` (`DEFAULT_REWARD_SETTINGS`); Admin > Commerce > Rewards tab, "Rewards on". The server copies of the rules in `api/create-order.ts` and `api/notify-order.ts` are kept in sync by `npm run sync:rewards`.
- **Scratch & Win:** Firestore `siteSettings/scratchWin`; defaults in `src/lib/scratchWin.ts`; Admin > Commerce > Scratch & Win tab, "Scratch & Win on". Cards are only handed out while rewards are running too.
- **Dealers:** Firestore `siteSettings/dealer` (public: on/off and minimum order) and `dealerPricing/current` (private: discount and fixed prices); defaults in `src/lib/dealer.ts`; Admin > Commerce > Dealers tab, "Dealer programme". Applications are reviewed in Admin > Dealers.
- **Customer promises follow the live setting.** `src/hooks/useRewardSettings.ts` (`useRewardsLive`) is off until the first read and on a failed read, and is used by the home promise band and tiles, sign-up copy, header button, wallet and account. Never write a points promise that skips it. These tabs hold placeholder values until the client confirms its rules.

## Adding a switch

1. Add the key to `FeatureKey`, `FEATURES` and `FEATURE_INFO` in `src/config/features.ts` (label, description, and `dependsOn` if it needs another feature).
2. Wrap the feature's routes in `<FeatureGate feature="...">` in `src/App.tsx` (admin routes use `fallback="/admin/dashboard"`).
3. Hide its links, admin sidebar entry (`AdminLayout.tsx`), account and footer entries and home sections with `isOn()`; skip its Firestore listeners when off.
4. Add its row to the Switches table above (default, size, what off hides, main files).
5. Run `npm test`: this file is checked by `tests/features-doc.test.ts` (one row per key, the default and a size).
